state.description: Configuration stage that was last completed for the specified location. The order of precedence is `LOCATION_SETUP`, `ALERTS`, `NETWORK_ELEMENTS`, `ROUTING_ENABLE`. If at least one location is `LOCATION_SETUP`, then `locationState` will be set to `LOCATION_SETUP`. Otherwise, `locationState` will check for the next precedence option and at least one location should have that option.
